question: Simplify (5x − 2y)² + (2x + 5y)² + (5x + 2y)(5x − 2y).
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify (5x - 2y)² + (2x + 5y)² + (5x + 2y)(5x - 2y).

**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b²

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a + b)(a - b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

(5x - 2y)² = 25x² - 20xy + 4y²

(2x + 5y)² = 4x² + 20xy + 25y²

(5x + 2y)(5x - 2y) = 25x² - 4y²

⇒ (5x - 2y)² + (2x + 5y)² + (5x + 2y)(5x - 2y)

⇒ (25x² - 20xy + 4y²) + (4x² + 20xy + 25y²) + (25x² - 4y²)

⇒ 25x² + 4x² + 25x² - 20xy + 20xy + 4y² + 25y² - 4y²

⇒ 54x² + 25y²

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
